svg.title: Recorded timing structure remains in the supplied groups

cc:Work.dc:title: Recorded timing structure remains in the supplied groups
cc:Work.dc:description: Empirical cumulative distributions for all adjacent PP and NN pairs in the frozen heights 0–49999. This is separate from the fast-PPN timing test; no preceding-gap filter is used. The zoom window does not remove observations from either denominator. Differences are recorded header times. The supplied labels are not independently validated by this plot.
